chunks: I call to witness the lucent Book,

key_terms.الْكِتَابِ: The Book, referring to the Quran
key_terms.الْمُبِينِ: The Clear, The Manifest, The One that makes things clear

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being described as the 'Lucent Book' (Al-Kitab Al-Mubin)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Kitab Al-Mubin' underscores the Quran's role as the ultimate criterion (Furqan) that distinguishes truth from falsehood, often linked with the infallible Imams as its living interpreters. This phrase highlights the text's self-evident clarity, serving as a foundational witness to its divine origin and authority in guiding the faithful through explicit signs.
